BPF loader v3 constants and APIs for state, deployment, execution, and direct deploy.

# Purpose
This header defines the interface and constants for the BPF loader program used by the runtime. It declares compute unit values, account state sizes, and mapped instruction error codes that match Solana loader behavior. The file also declares functions to read loader state from an account, deploy a program, execute BPF code, and run the loader entry point. In addition, it exposes [`fd_directly_invoke_loader_v3_deploy`](<#fd_directly_invoke_loader_v3_deploy>) for direct program deployment during core BPF migration at an epoch boundary.
# Function Declarations (Public API)

---
- `fd_bpf_loader_program_get_state`
- `fd_deploy_program`
- `fd_bpf_execute`
- `fd_bpf_loader_program_execute`
- `fd_directly_invoke_loader_v3_deploy`
